methodology_corrections: Replaced hardcoded SELECTED_THRESHOLD = 0.5 with programmatic validation-only optimization.
Implemented true source-holdout training and evaluation.
Increased latency benchmark sample size to 1,000 validation records.
Expanded metrics to report 3-way confusion matrix and specific FPRs (benign-to-malicious, benign-to-any-nonbenign).

threshold_selection.policy: Minimize benign-to-any-nonbenign FPR subject to malicious recall >= 0.50

blockers: Hard-negative FPR is unacceptably high (27.27%), failing the critical security gate.
dataset_gaps: Multilingual coverage (e.g. Hinglish) is statistically insignificant.
